QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: enabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Control a loudspeaker payload that answers on the aircraft network. The payload stores the audio files; the ground station only selects which one to play.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enable loudspeaker payload

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ipAddress
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Where the ground station sends loudspeaker commands. On the SIYI datalink this is the controller's local UDP bridge (loopback), which forwards them to the payload over the air unit serial link.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Loudspeaker IP address

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: port
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: UDP port for loudspeaker commands. On the SIYI datalink this is the controller's local bridge port (19856).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Loudspeaker command port

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: messageNames
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Comma separated labels for the stored audio files, in track order. The first name is track 1. These are only labels for the buttons; the audio itself lives on the payload.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Broadcast message names
